title: eps-ground-rupture — interactive companion to Chiama et al. (2025)
description:
A reproducible pipeline and companion website for the 2D distinct element method (DEM) surface-rupture analyses of Chiama et al. (2025). The pipeline cleans the published model outputs and field compilations into tidy Parquet, derives thirteen DuckDB views pinned by tests, and exports the CSV tables behind five interactive Tableau Public dashboards. The site documents what each dashboard answers, how every number is computed, and where each departs from the printed figures.

This record identifies the software and website. It does not replace the citation for the paper, nor for the underlying data, which is deposited separately on DesignSafe-CI.

Figures. The paper's figures shown on the companion website are reproduced from the authors' accepted manuscript and are included in this archive, under subprojects/mkdocs/docs/images/. They are not covered by the Apache-2.0 licence of this record: they remain © The Author(s) 2025 and are shared under the publisher's author-sharing terms — non-commercial use, no derivatives, with the full citation alongside. Only Figures 1 and 2 are excluded, because they embed photographs belonging to other authors.
